easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Phyrexian Walker is starting in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.

Resolve the Phyrexian Walker spell. Then, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
